steps.assert: document.querySelectorAll('.boot-section').length === 6 || 'expected launch log, journal, pstore, device, kernel args, params'
document.querySelector('.log-dialog').textContent.includes('(256 bytes of binary)') || 'a binary param shows its size'
fetch(document.querySelector('.log-head a.icon-btn').href).then((r) => r.text()).then((t) => t.includes('==== pstore/console-ramoops-0 ====\nKernel panic') || 'download should hold every section')
document.querySelector('.log-head .nowrap').textContent === '24 lines' || 'the filter should match 24 lines'
document.querySelector('dialog[open]') && !document.querySelector('.boot-filter').value || 'escape should clear the filter first'
document.querySelector('.log-dialog .error').textContent.includes('not a capnp log') || 'a file that is not a log should say so'
document.querySelector('.boot-filter').hidden && document.querySelector('.log-head a.icon-btn').href.endsWith('garbage.zst') || 'only the raw download is left'
